title: 100x your clarity on life, health, money, relations, parenting to live a meaningful life - G2G
creator: Rahul Jain
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (Good 2 Great podcast collaboration)
summary: A Good 2 Great podcast conversation with Manisha Lad Gupta, former CMO of Axis Bank and Uber India, who quit a Rs 10M salary to run a permaculture farm (Ananda, near Panchkula). The episode is an anti-consumerism life-design discussion: reject the endless 'upgrade' culture, build your nest egg first, invest early and avoid loans, and treat health in your 30s-40s as the capital that lets you enjoy wealth later. Gupta's core argument is that clarity on what 'enough' looks like beats chasing the next milestone. Rahul Jain adds that podcasting taught him more in six months than 16 years of corporate life. The money content stays at the level of generic life advice — save early, avoid debt — with no tickers, funds or specific instruments named. No explicit calls in this one.
